resources.string: When DiPlay opens, connect the selected iPhone using the saved connection settings.
Your existing connection settings are preserved. Start a wireless connection from the home screen.
Nearby devices connects your iPhone. Microphone enables Siri and calls. Older Android versions also require Location for wireless setup.

An independent CarPlay receiver for Android head units. Wireless connections run on the head unit, with local authentication. A standard iPhone can connect without a jailbreak, Mac, dongle or sign-in.\n\nThis preview uses an experimental accessory identity. Compatibility with every iPhone and head unit is still being tested. It is not an Apple-certified product.
